label: Best months
quote: Best time to visit Ushu Forest: June to September

label: Distance
value: About 8 to 10 km from Kalam, around 30 minutes
quote: Ushu Forest is located approximately 8–10 km from Kalam in upper Swat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

label: Road
value: Mostly a jeep track from Kalam
quote: The road from Kalam to Ushu Forest is mostly a jeep track.

label: Access
value: A 4x4 jeep is needed from Kalam; cars without high clearance cannot cross the river sections
quote: You must use a 4x4 jeep from Kalam.
source: Discover Swat, Mahodand Lake to Kalam jeep track guide

label: Jeep fare
value: Private return jeep from Kalam, PKR 6,000 to 8,000; shared seat PKR 1,000 to 1,500
quote: Private return jeep from Kalam costs PKR 6,000 to 8,000
source: Discover Swat, Mahodand Lake to Kalam jeep track guide

label: Winter
value: The jeep track typically closes from late December to early April because of snow
quote: The jeep track typically closes from late December to early April because of snow.
source: Discover Swat, Mahodand Lake to Kalam jeep track guide
